sections.heading: First-attempt duration across 56 commits
sections.text: KVM had the shorter first attempt in 55 of 56 complete manual pairs. The median within-pair saving was 4m48s. The exact sign interval was 4m14s to 5m44s (95.6% coverage under independent pairs). Arm medians were 8m35s on managed TCG and 3m33s on KVM. The incomplete batch shares a time window and executor fleet, and warm fixture reuse was more common on KVM (48 of 56 versus 17 of 56).

sections.heading: Queue and native execution
sections.text: Queued-to-worker-start was usable on all 67 managed executions and 27 of 56 KVM executions. Median and p90 among usable clocks were 0.1s and 0.6s on managed, and 3.8s and 109s on KVM. The maximum usable KVM wait was 239s. The other 29 KVM clocks were inverted. Preparation medians were 1.5s on managed and 0.9s on KVM. These are native action clocks, including retries where recorded.

sections.heading: Ordinary devel pushes
sections.text: On three fresh devel pairs, KVM first attempts were 31s, 62s and 3m48s shorter. All KVM queue clocks in these pairs were inverted. The KVM shadow was triggered by the managed result. The manual arms ran concurrently, with up to six pairs in flight. Neither schedule measures the required PR critical path or KVM contention with Firecracker after cutover.

sections.heading: Required routing and follow-up
sections.text: The routing change moves the existing required Agentplane VM target to recycled KVM on the self-hosted BuildBuddy kvm-vm pool. Managed TCG continues as an optional devel shadow. The interim cohort predates the cutover. After cutover, check the required target’s first and final verdicts, cache exposure, queue and total time on fresh required runs. Compare Firecracker admission and execution over the same load window. The runs below do not measure the effect on required PR feedback.

devel_pod_concurrency.decision: Four Pod case slots landed through PR #16659. In its frozen unsplit 22-case cohort, all cases passed and mean action time fell from 363.3s to 289.2s (20.4%); the case envelope fell 29.8%. Pod requests, memory limits and executor sizing stayed fixed. The current required inventory is partitioned differently, so this is not a new port measurement.
devel_pod_concurrency.scope: Two fresh actions per setting, sequential order 2/4/4/2, with all 88 JUnit case executions passing. Input trees, executor properties and case identities are identical; decoded Commands differ only in the case-limit environment variable. All fixtures were distinct, infrastructure was warm, and cleanup completed. Mean setup was 35.2s at two slots and 40.4s at four; setup variation is separate from case concurrency. This small action screen does not establish whole-PR savings, p90, cold-start behavior or a fleet reliability rate. Two-slot action times ranged 335.6–391.1s; four-slot times ranged 285.2–293.1s. One trust probe took 94.5s in the slower control versus 12–17s elsewhere; its wait is not subdivided in existing traces, so that outlier is not attributed to concurrency. Against the faster control alone, the four-slot mean is 13.8% shorter; this is a sensitivity comparison, not a confidence bound.
devel_pod_concurrency.memory_finding: Maximum whole-action memory was 5.07 GiB at two slots and 5.12 GiB at four. Kubelet samples retained at least 4.51 GiB available and sampled up to 5 runtime Pods in the four-slot arm. Before-import/final snapshots contain no FailedScheduling, OOMKilled or eviction reasons. Ten-second sampling and snapshots can miss transient events.

OOM and swap counter increments are computed only between observed samples in the requested window; resets are counted and post-reset values are included. They are not lifetime totals.

Native memory.peak is the maximum observed sample from mapped buildbuddy-exec-* cgroups. The sampling interval is about 5 seconds, so it can miss the action's true final or instantaneous peak; the executor container is excluded.

            assert selection.source_sha == config['source']
            assert selection.base_sha == config['base']
            assert selection.pr_head_sha == config['pr_head']
            original = Path(selection.targets[0].split('=', 1)[1]).read_text().splitlines()
            original = sorted(set(original))
            assert original.count(config['control']) == 1
            roots = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(original) + ')')
            assert set(roots) == set(original)
            assert not any(x['kind'] in {'alias', 'test_suite'} for x in roots.values()), 'Suites/aliases require explicit expansion review'
            assert not any('manual' in x['tags'] for x in roots.values())
            tests = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--query_file=' + str(selection.test_query)]).splitlines()
            test_info = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(tests) + ')')
            runnable = sorted(x for x in tests if not {'manual', 'live_openai_api'}.intersection(test_info[x]['tags']))
            assert runnable == config['reference_tests'], 'Runnable graph differs from original exact CI inventory'
            targets = original
            flags = ['--nocache_test_results', '--flaky_test_attempts=1', '--runs_per_test=1', '--test_output=errors']
            expected = runnable
            if config['candidate_arm']:
                targets = sorted([x for x in original if x != config['control']] + [config['candidate']])
                candidate_info = inventory(config['candidate'])
                assert candidate_info[config['candidate']]['kind'].endswith('_test')
                assert 'manual' in candidate_info[config['candidate']]['tags']
                expected = sorted([x for x in runnable if x != config['control']] + [config['candidate']])
                flags.append('--test_tag_filters=-live_openai_api')
            target_file = root / 'experiment-test-targets.txt'

            query = root / 'experiment-test-query.txt'
            query.write_text('tests(set(' + ' '.join(targets) + '))\n')
            actual_tests = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--query_file=' + str(query)]).splitlines()
            actual_info = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(actual_tests) + ')')
            manual = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if 'manual' in actual_info[x]['tags'])
            assert manual == ([config['candidate']] if config['candidate_arm'] else [])
            excluded = {'live_openai_api'} if config['candidate_arm'] else {'manual', 'live_openai_api'}
            actual_runnable = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if not excluded.intersection(actual_info[x]['tags']))
            assert actual_runnable == expected
            record = {
                'source': dataclasses.asdict(selection) | {'test_query': str(selection.test_query)},
                'arm': config['arm'], 'original_roots': original, 'root_inventory': roots,
                'original_selected_tests': tests, 'original_test_inventory': test_info,
                'test_roots': targets, 'runnable_tests': expected, 'test_flags': flags,
                'build_roots': original, 'test_invocation': os.environ['TEST_INVOCATION_ID'],
                'build_invocation': os.environ['BUILD_INVOCATION_ID'],
            }
            print('GRAPH_SELECTION_JSON=' + json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
            snapshot = root / 'selected-test-labels.json'
            ci._write_selected_test_labels(snapshot, actual_tests, dataclasses.replace(selection, targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], test_query=query))
            ci._probe('before-test')
            result = ci._run_bazel('test', role='test', targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], extra_flags=tuple(flags), check=False)
            if result.returncode:
                return result.returncode
            ci._probe('after-test')
            ci._run_bazel('build', role='build', targets=selection.targets)
            ci._probe('after-build')
            return 0
        finally:
            ci._finalize_probe(snapshot)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main(CONFIG))

backend_graph_comparison.summary: The control and cold seed passed 242 cases each in 8m22s and 9m44s. The first repeat verified 38.6s warm Firecracker setup, but a managed executor kernel panic stopped the comparison. Two remaining arms were not run. Full-graph speedup remains unqualified.
backend_graph_comparison.source_note: Manual replay of PR #17529 with merged readiness repair #17553 applied identically to the frozen base, PR head and merge trees. Other files retain their original contents.
backend_graph_comparison.stop_reason: candidate-repeat-1 had a managed VM executor kernel panic and an automatic provider reschedule. The replacement was cancelled under the failure stop rule. candidate-repeat-2 and control-last were never submitted.
findings: The History readiness repair merged as #17553. Its gated one-shot-read negative control reproduced the original assertion; all five bounded-wait cases, the changed library checks and all 42 CI-selected targets passed. Both launch/restart harness cases passed in each of the three new graph exposures: six observed case passes. This does not estimate a fleet flake rate.

The normal control passed test and build in 8m22s; the cold recycling seed passed in 9m44s. Each preserved the original 94 build roots, 57 runnable targets, 75 fresh native executions, 75 exact native/BES JUnit joins and all 242 original case identities, with no skips. The control and seed had identical inputs, commands and platforms for all 74 non-Firecracker actions.

The first repeat verified one warm Firecracker chain from the seed: same native runner, executor registration, Docker container, K3s process/node and PKI controllers; fresh action, workload, credential, storage and plugin identities; complete fixture cleanup and zero recorded cgroup OOMs. Setup was 38.6s versus 107.3s in the cold seed; Firecracker process time was 278.4s versus 335.1s. This is one verified repeat, not a fleet hit rate or full-graph speedup.

The managed VM action in that repeat failed with UNAVAILABLE and exit -2. Its recovered executor log shows a general protection fault in update_blocked_averages on CPU 9 / PID 0, kernel banner 5.15.0 #1, then a panic attempting to kill the idle task and a reboot. The executor Firecracker process stopped, explaining the refused control socket. The cause of the invalid kernel pointer is not established; the observed crash is in the BuildBuddy-managed executor, separate from our in-cluster Firecracker test runner.

BuildBuddy automatically created a replacement execution although Bazel test retries were disabled. The repeat therefore has 76 native execution records for the planned 75 actions. It was cancelled at 06:45:17 UTC after the provider failure: its 15m09 submission-to-cancellation duration includes waiting for the replacement and is not a successful latency sample or a time-to-first-failure clock. Two later arms were not submitted.

Across the three submitted arms, 224 JUnit artifacts have exact native/BES hash, size and path joins, containing 724 observed passing case verdicts. The interrupted repeat has 240 passing verdicts; its two planned managed-VM case identities have no JUnit verdict. The failed provider attempt has empty stdout/stderr and an empty declared output tree, so its additional scenario exposure and teardown are also unknown. Only the first two arms establish all four strict managed-guest shutdowns; none is claimed for the interrupted repeat.

The control was last finished by managed VM (373.1s native process). The cold seed was last finished by Firecracker after 129.0s native queueing and 42.7s worker preparation, with the 8.9s input fetch nested inside preparation. """Manual frozen-graph replay; execution policy is explicit in the injected config."""
import dataclasses
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'devinfra/ci'))
import bazel_ci as ci


def inventory(query):
    data = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--output=xml', query])
    result = {}
    for node in ET.fromstring(data):
        name = node.attrib.get('name')
        if not name:
            continue
        tags = node.find("list[@name='tags']")
        result[name] = {'kind': node.attrib.get('class', node.tag), 'tags': [] if tags is None else [x.attrib['value'] for x in tags]}
    return result


def main(config):
    assert ci._git_output('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == config['source']
    with ci._module_lockfile_cache(), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ducktape-backend-graph-') as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        snapshot = None
        try:
            selection = ci._select_targets(root)
            assert not selection.full_sweep, 'Expected affected-target backend graph'
            assert selection.source_sha == config['source']
            assert selection.base_sha == config['base']
            assert selection.pr_head_sha == config['pr_head']
            original = Path(selection.targets[0].split('=', 1)[1]).read_text().splitlines()
            original = sorted(set(original))
            assert original.count(config['control']) == 1
            if 'reference_roots' in config:
                assert original == config['reference_roots'], 'Build roots differ from frozen baseline graph'
            roots = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(original) + ')')
            assert set(roots) == set(original)
            assert not any(x['kind'] in {'alias', 'test_suite'} for x in roots.values()), 'Suites/aliases require explicit expansion review'
            assert not any('manual' in x['tags'] for x in roots.values())
            tests = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--query_file=' + str(selection.test_query)]).splitlines()
            test_info = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(tests) + ')')
            runnable = sorted(x for x in tests if not {'manual', 'live_openai_api'}.intersection(test_info[x]['tags']))
            assert runnable == config['reference_tests'], 'Runnable graph differs from original exact CI inventory'
            targets = original
            flags = ['--nocache_test_results', '--flaky_test_attempts=1', '--runs_per_test=1', '--test_output=errors']
            expected = runnable
            if config['candidate_arm']:
                targets = sorted([x for x in original if x != config['control']] + [config['candidate']])
                candidate_info = inventory(config['candidate'])
                assert candidate_info[config['candidate']]['kind'].endswith('_test')
                assert 'manual' in candidate_info[config['candidate']]['tags']
                expected = sorted([x for x in runnable if x != config['control']] + [config['candidate']])
                flags.append('--test_tag_filters=-live_openai_api')
            target_file = root / 'experiment-test-targets.txt'
            target_file.write_text('\n'.join(targets) + '\n')
            query = root / 'experiment-test-query.txt'
            query.write_text('tests(set(' + ' '.join(targets) + '))\n')
            actual_tests = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--query_file=' + str(query)]).splitlines()
            actual_info = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(actual_tests) + ')')
            manual = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if 'manual' in actual_info[x]['tags'])
            assert manual == ([config['candidate']] if config['candidate_arm'] else [])
            excluded = {'live_openai_api'} if config['candidate_arm'] else {'manual', 'live_openai_api'}
            actual_runnable = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if not excluded.intersection(actual_info[x]['tags']))
            assert actual_runnable == expected
            record = {
                'source': dataclasses.asdict(selection) | {'test_query': str(selection.test_query)},
                'arm': config['arm'], 'original_roots': original, 'root_inventory': roots,
                'original_selected_tests': tests, 'original_test_inventory': test_info,
                'test_roots': targets, 'runnable_tests': expected, 'test_flags': flags,
                'build_roots': original, 'test_invocation': os.environ['TEST_INVOCATION_ID'],
                'build_invocation': os.environ['BUILD_INVOCATION_ID'],
            }
            print('GRAPH_SELECTION_JSON=' + json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
            snapshot = root / 'selected-test-labels.json'
            ci._write_selected_test_labels(snapshot, actual_tests, dataclasses.replace(selection, targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], test_query=query))
            ci._probe('before-test')
            result = ci._run_bazel('test', role='test', targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], extra_flags=tuple(flags), check=False)
            if result.returncode:
                return result.returncode
            ci._probe('after-test')
            ci._run_bazel('build', role='build', targets=selection.targets)
            ci._probe('after-build')
            return 0
        finally:
            ci._finalize_probe(snapshot)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main(CONFIG))

                assert 'manual' in candidate_info[config['candidate']]['tags']
                expected = sorted([x for x in runnable if x != config['control']] + [config['candidate']])
                flags.append('--test_tag_filters=-live_openai_api')
            target_file = root / 'experiment-test-targets.txt'
            target_file.write_text('\n'.join(targets) + '\n')
            query = root / 'experiment-test-query.txt'

            actual_tests = ci._capture(['bazel', 'query', '--query_file=' + str(query)]).splitlines()
            actual_info = inventory('set(' + ' '.join(actual_tests) + ')')
            manual = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if 'manual' in actual_info[x]['tags'])
            assert manual == ([config['candidate']] if config['candidate_arm'] else [])
            excluded = {'live_openai_api'} if config['candidate_arm'] else {'manual', 'live_openai_api'}
            actual_runnable = sorted(x for x in actual_tests if not excluded.intersection(actual_info[x]['tags']))
            assert actual_runnable == expected
            record = {
                'source': dataclasses.asdict(selection) | {'test_query': str(selection.test_query)},
                'arm': config['arm'], 'original_roots': original, 'root_inventory': roots,
                'original_selected_tests': tests, 'original_test_inventory': test_info,
                'test_roots': targets, 'runnable_tests': expected, 'test_flags': flags,
                'build_roots': original, 'test_invocation': os.environ['TEST_INVOCATION_ID'],
                'build_invocation': os.environ['BUILD_INVOCATION_ID'],
            }
            print('GRAPH_SELECTION_JSON=' + json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
            snapshot = root / 'selected-test-labels.json'
            ci._write_selected_test_labels(snapshot, actual_tests, dataclasses.replace(selection, targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], test_query=query))
            ci._probe('before-test')
            result = ci._run_bazel('test', role='test', targets=['--target_pattern_file=' + str(target_file)], extra_flags=tuple(flags), check=False)
            if result.returncode:
                return result.returncode
            ci._probe('after-test')
            ci._run_bazel('build', role='build', targets=selection.targets)
            ci._probe('after-build')
            return 0
        finally:
